title: frametrail:attributes of type "video"
description: Video file (MP4, WebM or HLS). This schema describes the frametrail:attributes of items (and the attributes of resources) whose type is "video". On overlays, opacity, hoverStyle, zIndex and animation apply as on every overlay type. Unknown keys are allowed; writers keep them.

autoPlay.description: Overlays only: play in sync with the hypervideo while the overlay is active.

alternateVideoFile.description: Legacy. A second rendition of the video file. Not read.
